get.description: Dependency/circuit-breaker status for ops dashboards (v9-1 resilience).

Hosted demo page that embeds the chat widget (PHASE C). A visitor can paste a
publishable key (`pk_*`, read-only — safe for client-side embedding) and a tenant name

Lightweight operator console — a real HTML page (no raw curl) for tenant management,
per-tenant document lists, and widget config. The operator pastes the Admin-Key in the
browser; it is sent only as the Admin-Key header to the API. The page itself is unauthenticated
(it renders an input); every data call behind it is Admin-Key gated and fail-closed.

Hosted source viewer for citation deep-links (issue #6).

Rendered as a real, openable page so every citation is a clickable link — including for
documents ingested by upload/text (which have no external `source_url`). The tenant's
secret key is read from the URL *fragment* (`#token=...`) so it is never sent to the
server in the request line or leaked via Referer; the page then fetches the document via
the API with `Authorization: Bearer ***.
v9-5: current SLO status (availability + p95 latency) vs configured targets.
Read the hash-chained audit trail. Admin-gated (fail-closed like /metrics).
Verify chain integrity. `ok=False` + `first_break_id` indicates tampering.

Fetch a document's full content (all chunks) for the hosted source viewer / citation
deep-links (issue #6). Secret-key gated so a link can't expose another tenant's content.

Return the tenant's branding so the embeddable widget can self-theme.

Uses TenantDep (any key tier) so the widget's loader — which only holds the tenant's
secret key — can fetch it. Branding is non-sensitive display configuration.

replay prior context after a reload. Tenant-scoped (key resolves tenant; path tenant must

Set/update a tenant's widget branding (admin only). Sanitized server-side.

post.description:
Onboard a client site by crawling its sitemap.xml. Returns a job_id to poll.

Respectful crawler: honors robots.txt (Allow/Disallow + Crawl-delay), caps
concurrency and total URLs, and reuses the SSRF-safe fetcher. Re-crawls are
idempotent (each URL is upserted under a stable per-URL doc_key from issue #4), so
re-running a sitemap REPLACES changed pages instead of duplicating them.

Upload a file (PDF / Markdown / HTML / code / text) and ingest it (issue #10).

multipart/form-data: `file` (required), `title` (optional), `content_type` (optional,
auto-detected from extension/MIME), `metadata` (optional JSON object string),
`acl` (optional JSON array of groups). PDFs use pypdf; DOCX uses python-docx (clear 400
if the parser is missing). Re-uploading the same file REPLACES prior chunks (issue #4
per-file doc_key), so it never duplicates.

Issue a new API key for this tenant. The old key remains valid until revoked.

v10.8: the new key may be time-boxed via body.expires_at (UTC ISO-8601). Missing body
mints a non-expiring key (backward compatible).

v10.8: mint an additional full-power secret key (rk_*), optionally time-boxed.

Distinct from POST /{tenant}/keys (rotate) so callers can add non-rotating keys.

patch.description: v10.8: set or clear a key's expiry (time-boxed keys) by prefix. None = never expire.

post.description:
P1 #9: mint a read-only key (pk_*) safe to embed client-side in the widget.

The publishable key resolves to the SAME tenant (isolation unchanged) but is
scope-locked to query endpoints by require_secret_key(); it cannot ingest, delete,
rotate, or revoke. A tenant may hold any number of publishable keys plus secret keys.
v10.8: the key may be time-boxed via body.expires_at. Missing body = non-expiring.

v9-4: evaluate answer QUALITY (faithfulness + relevancy) via self-hosted LLM judge,
plus classic retrieval metrics. Persists a run to the trend history when persist=True.

DocumentCatalogItem.title: DocumentCatalogItem
DocumentCatalogItem.description:
One row in a tenant's index catalog (issue #12).

Exposes only tenant-relevant fields. The internal `doc_key` (registry stability key)
is intentionally NOT surfaced.

DocumentCatalogPage.title: DocumentCatalogPage
DocumentCatalogPage.description: Paginated catalog response (issue #12): items + true total + paging cursor.

DocumentChunkOut.title: DocumentChunkOut
DocumentChunkOut.description: A single chunk of a document, as returned by the source viewer (issue #6).

DocumentChunksOut.title: DocumentChunksOut
DocumentChunksOut.description: Full document content for the hosted source viewer / citation deep-links (issue #6).

acl.title: Acl
acl.description: Optional sub-user group ids allowed to see this doc (document-level RBAC).

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: sha256 of the cleaned indexed content (GitHub issue #4). Two ingests of identical content share a hash, enabling idempotent re-ingestion.

previous_doc_id.title: Previous Doc Id
previous_doc_id.description: When this ingest replaced a prior version of the same source, the doc_id that was superseded (and whose chunks were deleted). Absent on first ingest / identical re-ingest.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 expiry (e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z), or null to clear.

KeyExpiryRequest.title: KeyExpiryRequest
KeyExpiryRequest.description: v10.8: set/clear a key's expiry by prefix. None = clear (never expires).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Optional UTC ISO-8601 expiry for the publishable key.

PublishableKeyRequest.title: PublishableKeyRequest
PublishableKeyRequest.description: P1 #9 + v10.8: mint a read-only publishable key, optionally time-boxed.

acl.title: Acl
acl.description: Sub-user group ids of the caller; restricts retrieval to chunks whose acl intersects these groups (document-level RBAC). Server-validated against the tenant's provisioned allowed_groups.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Conversation session id. When set, the question is rewritten against prior turns (follow-up resolution) and history is recorded. Enables a chat widget.

rewrite.title: Rewrite
rewrite.description: Pre-retrieval query rewriting (PHASE B): clarify/expand short queries and decompose multi-part questions before the vector search. Set false to skip (use the raw question verbatim). Passthrough when no LLM is configured.

hops.title: Hops
hops.description: Multi-hop retrieval depth (PHASE C). 1 = single retrieval (default). >1 requires a plan that permits multi-hop (enterprise/pro); standard tenants requesting >1 receive 402. Capped at 5.

rewritten_query.title: Rewritten Query
rewritten_query.description: The self-contained query actually used for retrieval (pre-retrieval and/or conversational rewriting applied). Useful for transparency/debugging.

sub_questions.title: Sub Questions
sub_questions.description: Sub-questions the query was decomposed into when it was multi-part/comparative (PHASE B). Empty list when single-part. Surfaced for transparency/observability.

hop_count.title: Hop Count
hop_count.description: Number of retrieval hops actually executed (PHASE C). 1 for single retrieval; >1 when multi-hop was used. None when not applicable.

faithfulness.title: Faithfulness
faithfulness.description: Estimated grounding score of the generated answer vs retrieved context (PHASE D), 0..1. Higher = more faithful. None when no answer was generated.

answerable.title: Answerable
answerable.description: Whether the answer is grounded in / supported by the retrieved context (PHASE D). False for a safe 'I don't know' refusal. None when no answer was generated.

out_of_scope.title: Out Of Scope
out_of_scope.description: True when retrieval confidence was below threshold (or no context found): the answer is a graceful 'no information' handoff, not a grounded answer.

injection_detected.title: Injection Detected
injection_detected.description: True when the user turn matched an injection/jailbreak guardrail pattern.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when a backend dependency (Qdrant/embedder/reranker) was degraded or unavailable and the service returned a best-effort response instead of failing.

rerank_score.title: Rerank Score
rerank_score.description: Post-rerank cross-encoder score, when reranking is enabled. `score` always reflects the ordering shown to the client (rerank_score when available, else the fusion score), so consumers must not re-sort by `score`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Optional UTC ISO-8601 expiry for the new secret key.

SecretKeyRequest.title: SecretKeyRequest
SecretKeyRequest.description: v10.8: mint an additional secret key, optionally time-boxed.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: http(s) URL to a logo image.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Primary accent color as a safe CSS color (#rgb(a) or rgb()/hsl()).

accent_text.title: Accent Text
accent_text.description: Text/icon color on the accent background (safe CSS color).

font_family.title: Font Family
font_family.description: CSS font-family stack (letters, spaces, commas, dashes only).

TenantBranding.title: TenantBranding
TenantBranding.description:
Per-tenant widget branding (issue #23). All fields optional; validated/sanitized
server-side before being returned to the widget.

allowed_groups.title: Allowed Groups
allowed_groups.description: Server-side RBAC: sub-user group labels this tenant is provisioned to use. SECURITY (v9-SEC-D): the default (None/'*') grants NO isolation between sub-users within the tenant — every caller can request any group label, so document-level RBAC provides zero intra-tenant separation. To enable real sub-user isolation, operators MUST pass an explicit group list (e.g. ['support','billing']) and ingest docs with a matching acl. '*' is only safe for single-user tenants. Operator/admin-set only.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Per-tenant widget branding (issue #23): {logo_url, header_title, accent, accent_text, font_family}. Applied by the embeddable widget via CSS custom properties. Server-side validated/sanitized before use.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: PHASE D (#35): per-tenant custom system prompt / persona (operator-trusted config, NOT end-user input). Prepended as a real `system` message to generation; empty/None = default generic grounding prompt.

TenantSystemPromptIn.title: TenantSystemPromptIn
TenantSystemPromptIn.description:
PHASE D (#35): operator-set persona. Admin-only. It is OPERATOR-trusted config (not
end-user input), so it is NOT subject to the user-input injection filtering owned by the
parallel P0/P1 security session. Max length keeps the persisted blob bounded.

WidgetConfigOut.title: WidgetConfigOut
WidgetConfigOut.description: Branding payload the embeddable widget fetches to self-theme (issue #23).
